description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeDistributionBySubunit' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Dashboard\\Dto'. The class models data related to employee distribution across subunits, encapsulating properties such as subunit count pairs, counts of other and unassigned employees, total subunit count, and a limit. It provides a constructor for initialization and getter methods for accessing the properties.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunit
classes.description: A data transfer object representing the distribution of employees by subunit, including counts and limits.

methods.name: getSubunitCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of subunit count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees categorized as 'other'.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unassigned employees.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit value for display or processing.

methods.name: getTotalSubunitCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of subunits.
